name: kracey
description: Kracey race predictions, HYROX pacing, saved race comparisons and training analysis.

interface.longDescription: Kracey computes running and HYROX race predictions, HYROX pacing targets, and comparisons between your saved HYROX races. Estimate a finish time from a running result, work back from a HYROX goal to lap and station times, or see where time changed between races. You can also review your training volume, best running efforts and session pace-zone minutes, and find upcoming HYROX and hybrid fitness races. A Kracey account is required. Personal training views need training data connected to Kracey through intervals.icu; calculators work from the numbers you provide. The plugin reads only your connected account and changes nothing. Predictions are estimates, not guaranteed results.
defaultPrompt: What running and HYROX times does Kracey predict from my recent training?
What pacing would I need for a 75-minute HYROX Men Open finish?
Compare my two latest saved HYROX races. Where did my time change?
